title: 大连百傲化学股份有限公司 2024 年年度报告
notes: Acquired directly from cninfo (static.cninfo.com.cn) per the local-first rule; sha256 and the 203-page count were computed locally (shasum -a 256; pdfinfo), not copied from any secondary source. Issuer: 大连百傲化学股份有限公司, SSE code 603360 (physical p4, 释义 table: '百傲化学、公司、本公司 指 大连百傲化学股份有限公司'). Same table defines 芯慧联新 (指 芯慧联新（苏州）科技有限公司，本公司之参股公司) and 芯慧联 (指 苏州芯慧联半导体科技有限公司，本公司之控股子公司) — two legally distinct sibling entities produced by a 2024 derivative split (派生分立); 芯慧联 (consolidated subsidiary from Dec 2024) carries 黄光制程/湿法清洗/自动化设备 businesses and is OUT OF SCOPE for this HBM-bonding intake; 芯慧联新 (equity-method associate only, 10.4822% held via wholly-owned subsidiary 上海芯傲华) carries the wafer-bonding/HBM business and is the entity registered here. Physical p9 (第二节 二、报告期内公司所处行业情况 / 三、报告期内公司从事的业务情况) states the company's 全资子公司芯傲华 made a CNY 100m capital increase into 芯慧联新 '期后' (after the reporting period, i.e. a subsequent event in substance, though the document does not use the formal heading 期后事项 at this passage) and describes its business and shipped-for-testing status (see entity/application-link excerpts). Reporting period end 2024-12-31; printed page numbers on p4 and p9 match the physical page number ('9 / 203' footer confirmed on p9), i.e. no offset.
